findings: The native recorder exists before worker startup, so first publication can be observed before native initialization.
Published and first Received records follow the metadata mailbox lock; Core records every actual installation, including recovery of the same authored plan.
First receipt is recorded once across preparation retry. Superseded unread inputs have no invented receipt, installation or zero-latency sample.
CPU plan handoff/first-use and retained plan age at accepted output APIs are measured by exact authored/resource identities.
Retained plan age grows between edits; it is not edit latency, GPU queue time, physical presentation age or a cross-context GPU critical path.
Neither M03 native recovery nor full renderer qualification is closed by these bounded measurements.
limitations: Only one short diagnostic sample per scenario; prescribed durations and repetitions remain open.
GPU/presentation queue, native-window age, critical path and environment pinning remain unavailable.
All missing lifecycle/counter/frame joins remain incomplete; existing failed captures and budgets are preserved.
